name: bkit
description: Classical machine learning for Bantu: scikit-learn's shape, with a histogram-based gradient-boosting implementation inside it rather than beside it. Phases K1-K7 of twelve: the estimator protocol, Pipeline with step__param addressing, eleven preprocessing transformers, model selection, metrics, linear models -- LinearRegression, Ridge, Lasso, ElasticNet, LogisticRegression (binary IRLS, multiclass one-vs-rest) and mini-batch SGD -- ColumnTransformer for per-column preprocessing, and decision trees over the tree_ native family -- histogram-based, one byte per binned cell, with the NaN direction learned per split. Both trees use the same regularised gain the gradient booster will: for regression it IS variance reduction, and for binary classification it is proportional to Gini decrease, so one criterion serves both. No model forms X'X: the Gram matrix squares the condition number, so every fit goes through lstsq on the design matrix.
